pre_mortem: It's Monday and Brown under 45.5 lost the ticket because Cincinnati fell behind early, Burrow threw 40 times into a 36% blitz that this offense actually beats (+0.50 EPA), and Brown finished with 11 carries at the same 2.4 YPC he has shown, stuck in the mid-30s. The 5.28 YPC against Minnesota may have been two soft opponents, and nothing in the pack names who CIN has faced. A Mason over would have been the wrong pair: CIN allows 3.69 YPC and only one 10-plus run, and the Viking line is missing Kelly and Skule. A Jefferson under would have lost if Taylor-Britt sat and the backup force-fed him into a secondary that already allowed six 20-plus passes.
